subject: english
stem: What happens next in this passage after “Linda said she had folded the paper many times before finding a good shape.”?
options: During music class, the teacher played an old song.
She also used thicker paper from an old calendar.
She put paper, pencils, and old magazines on the tables and let students choose what to do.
The calendar helped the class remember more than homework.

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「Linda said she had folded the paper many times before finding a good shape. She also used thicker paper from an old calendar.」，答案為「She also used thicker paper from an old calendar.」。
